notes.title: Patch Notes – December 23, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello,
We’re sharing the details of today’s update.

[h2]Game Pack UI/UX Improvements[/h2]
- Based on survey results, the Game Pack UX has been improved.
- The number of game packs has been reduced to three categories: Classic, Chaos, and Precision.
[list]
- Classic: "Effort." Contains tools and traits requiring buildup to progress.
- Chaos: "Luck." Includes tools and traits with unpredictable results influenced by luck.
- Precision: "Skill." Features tools and traits that emphasize dice modification and strategic planning, minimizing randomness.
[/list]

[h2]Custom Game Pack Functionality Added[/h2]
- In addition to the three predefined packs, a new feature allows players to customize their own game packs.
- A custom pack must include a minimum of 60 tools and 30 traits.


[h2]New "Prophecy" Themed Tools Added (10)[/h2]
New "Prophecy" tools, requiring players to declare a sum and use the tool only if the declared sum matches, have been added to the Precision pack.

- Fumble: All dice rolls on the next turn result in the lowest value.
- Super Critical: All dice rolls on the next turn result in the highest value.
- Cassandra: The next attack by this character deals 200% damage.
- Helenus: The next damage this character takes is reduced by 50%.
- Sibyl: This character fully recovers HP.
- Herb: This character recovers HP equal to their dice bonus. The dice bonus is then reset to 0.
- Balamun: Deals 10 damage.
- Calchas: Deals 8 damage to all enemies.
- Pomona: Adds 5 armor to a target character.
- Nostradamus: Deals 15 damage and grants a die with values (1/1/2/2/3/3).


[h2]Balance Adjustment[/h2]
- Combo Suppression Subsystem: Damage is now reset at the start of each round.

Feedback indicated that using diverse deck concepts against the final boss was challenging. One issue identified was the excessive impact of the combo suppression subsystem. Damage now resets at the beginning of each round to better support buildup strategies.


[h2]Next Patch Preview[/h2]
While we had planned to introduce unique boss patterns for each game pack, testing revealed this approach still hindered the creation of diverse deck concepts. Instead, we aim to develop a system that collects data on player strategies during a game and adjusts boss patterns accordingly. Look forward to the next update on December 25.


Thank you!

notes.title: Survey Winner Announcement and Update Plans
notes.notes:
Hello,

The survey regarding the game pack feature has concluded.

The winner of the Steam gift card is hun*******. An email has been sent to the winner, so please check your inbox.

The survey results show that most participants responded positively to the game pack feature. However, a common piece of feedback highlighted that its UX is unclear, and we plan to address this in the next update.

As for the in-game difficulty balance, opinions were divided between making it easier, keeping it as it is, and making it harder. We will consider alternative solutions for this matter.

Below is the update schedule based on the survey feedback.

---

The next update is scheduled for December 22, 2024, and it will include the following features:

[b]1. Game Pack UX Improvements[/b]
We aim to simplify the selection process to reduce decision fatigue:

Each game pack will include 60 tools and 30 traits.
The total number of game packs will be reduced to 3–5 options.
Additionally, a "Custom Game Pack" feature will be introduced, allowing players to choose specific tools and traits to include in their game.
Players will also be able to save their custom configurations for future use.

[b]2. New "Prophecy" Tools/Traits[/b]
A new "Prophecy" mechanic will be introduced, where players can declare a dice total in advance and trigger effects if they hit the declared number.

10 tools and 5 traits related to this mechanic will be added.

[b]3. Boss Patterns Adjusted Based on Game Packs[/b]
The final boss's combat patterns will vary depending on the selected game pack.

[b]4. Update Cadence Announcement[/b]
Going forward, each game pack will consist of 60 tools. Updates will focus on adding one new game pack per update.

The update frequency is expected to be every two months.
Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes – November 18, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello,
We’re sharing the details of today’s update.

[h2]Story Replay Feature Added[/h2]
Thanks to suggestions from **-***ok0520 and ***5939 via Alteria, the story replay feature has been added to the game.
By selecting the "Memory Replay" menu on the title screen, you can revisit any story you’ve already seen.

[h2]UI/UX Improvements[/h2]
- The design of the Game Pack UI has been updated. Further improvements will be made to ensure a smoother experience for new players.

[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
- The balance of five underutilized traits has been improved:
Helmet: Start with 5 → 10 Armor.
Strategist: Deal 1 → 5 damage to all enemies whenever you draw a turn-condition tool.
Maximalist: At the start of combat, if your bag contains 20 → 15 or more tools, draw +1 tool.
Minimalist: At the start of combat, if your bag contains 3 → 4 or fewer tools, gain +1 die.
Last Stand: Previously activated when starting with 10 or fewer HP → Now triggers once per combat when HP drops to 10 or less, granting +1 die.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where BGM/SFX settings were not being properly loaded.

[h2]Next Patch Preview[/h2]
- A new game pack (10 tools and 5 traits) will be added. We encourage you to share your ideas for new tool concepts via Alteria, and we’ll incorporate as many as possible.
- The Game Pack UX will be further improved.

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes – October 22, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are sharing the update details applied on the morning of October 22.

[h2]Game Pack Feature Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047757/98a93f55a755837d3d70c1f4c651a09915094ff5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047757/78dde2d45d2a3040248199172caa0cb69dbcf453.jpg[/img]

A new Game Pack feature has been added, allowing players to play with only specific tools/traits.
Each pack consists of 10 cards and 5 traits, and players must choose at least 6 packs.
As a result, the tools appearing in the game will consist of tools/traits in the pack, unlocked tools, and custom tools.

A random game pack is pre-selected each time you start a new game. If you have any suggestions for improvements, please feel free to share them on the Steam Community or through Alteria.

[h2]Companion Recruitment Option Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047757/7c2de24b853d9a2d2c8241bc50c5271bd8ac639e.jpg[/img]
**-***ok0520’s suggestion through Alteria has been added, allowing players to recruit companions during the game.
You can now recruit specific characters as companions through dice rolls to fight alongside you. The following characters can be recruited:

Act 1: Fracta, Effugium, Peries, Tempest, Frau, Caedis, Briar, Lumen  
Act 2: Pragma, Heros, Fuga, Lesigna, Alienati 
Act 3: Lost One, Untrusting One, Cheering One

If you recruit a character as a companion, related events and boss fights will not feature that character.

[h2]New Tools Added[/h2]
- 8 new tools have been added to the Terrorist Pack, most of which add tools to the opponent’s bag.
- 10 new tools have been added to the Leader Pack, benefiting more from having a larger team.

[h2]New Traits Added[/h2]
- **Strategist Pack**: "Unity of Offense and Defense" has been added. Each time you deal damage to an opponent, your dice bonus increases.
- **Terrorist Pack**: "Inflation" has been added. At the start of the battle, all characters' draw counts increase by 1.
- **Terrorist Pack**: "One Plus One" has been added. When placing tools in the opponent’s bag, an additional tool is added.
- **Gambler Pack**: "Money Sense" has been added. The amount of gold obtained from tools is tripled.
- **Criminal Pack**: "It Stings" has been added. Damage taken from ally tools is reduced by 50%.
- **Martial Artist Pack**: "Fierce Assault" has been added. Damage ignoring defense is increased by 150%.
- **Martial Artist Pack**: "Victory at the Start" has been added. Upon successfully completing one combo, the next combo starts with 3.
- **Leader Pack**: Charisma, Improved Onboarding, Independent Action, True Friend, and Personable have been added. These traits assist in recruiting companions.

[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
- **Emergency Turret**: Damage when no tools are placed has been changed from 8 -> 5.

[h2]Tool Rarity Changes Notice[/h2]
With the addition of the Game Pack feature, the rarity of most tools has been adjusted.
Each pack is designed to contain 6 normal-grade, 3 rare-grade, and 1 unique-grade tool.
Due to the sheer number of changes, we are unable to list all the tool rarity adjustments ^O^;;

[h2]Next Patch Announcement[/h2]
- Due to the addition of new content, bug fixes have been delayed. We aim to resolve and update them as soon as possible.
- Content additions may cause stability issues, so please understand that daily updates may be necessary.
- Controller operation updates have also been delayed due to content addition-related stability issues.
- We plan to adjust the balance of less-used traits.
- Attack effects for the newly added tools will be added soon.

notes.title: Patch Notes – September 25, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are sharing today’s patch notes.

[h2]Improved Play Experience[/h2]
[list]
[*] After the ending, you will now be able to ask two questions at a time.
[*] After the ending, you will now be able to unlock two tools at a time.
[*] 'System Reboot,' which didn’t function properly in the Act 3 boss fight, has been removed. Initially, it was intended as a meta element where clicking it would return you to the title screen immediately, but it has been deemed unfair and thus removed.
[*] The options menu can no longer be opened when another popup is displayed.
[/list]

[h2]Balance: Shop Removal and Refresh Costs Adjustment[/h2]
This does not apply to Story Mode.
The price will increase if you remove or refresh items multiple times at a single shop. The price increase resets when you move to a different shop. The cost increases by 25G with each removal or refresh.
As the number of items for sale in shops increased from 6 to 10 in a previous patch, making it easier to build the desired bag, this change has been implemented.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Act 3 boss fight music did not loop.
[*] Fixed an issue where a battle would be considered a victory if an ally was removed while still having HP remaining.
[*] Fixed an issue where non-Korean/English users would see Korean as the default language when launching the game for the first time.
[*] Fixed an issue where the text order was displayed incorrectly in the battle log, such as "'Hick' placed in 'Preach’s' bag."
[/list]

[h2]Next Patch Preview[/h2]
[list]
[*] The previously announced rework of the Act 3 alien tools will be implemented.
[*] New alien resources are in production.
[*] The UX issue where actions couldn't be canceled after selecting a choice will be improved.
[*] We will make it clearer what caused a character's death in the game.
[*] Although we're not sure if it will be ready for the next patch, we plan to display the outcomes of story choices you've already experienced.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes – September 21, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are sharing today’s patch notes.

[h2]Difficulty Mode Patch[/h2]
Although the Hard Mode patch was announced for Sunday, we managed to complete it sooner, and the update will be live today. After selecting your character, you can choose from the following difficulty modes:

Story Mode: Start with 5 tools of your choice and a mode where damage is reduced by 50%.
Normal Mode: Same as the existing game.
Hard Mode: A mode with 10 stages of restrictions. Achievements are available.

You must clear each stage of Hard Mode before proceeding to the next.

[h2]Balance: Player-Exclusive Tools Buff[/h2]
Due to feedback indicating a lack of the feeling of getting stronger, the performance of all player-exclusive tools has been buffed to ensure that rewards are always stronger than basic tools in the bag.
[list]
[*] Molotov: 10 -> 12 damage
[*] BB Gun: 5 -> 7 damage
[*] Baton: 7 -> 9 damage
[*] Golf Club: 8 -> 10 damage
[*] Taser: 7 -> 8 damage
[*] Wrench: 5 -> 7 damage
[*] Rusty Knife: [Condition] Total 8 -> 7 or higher
[*] Toy Crossbow: 5 -> 7 damage
[*] Mini Drone: 5 -> 7 damage
[*] Iai: 10 -> 12 damage
[*] Glass Shard: 2 -> 4 damage
[*] Soccer Ball: 10 -> 12 damage
[*] Fragmentation Grenade: 7 -> 8 damage
[*] EOD Suit: [Condition] Total 10 -> 9 or higher
[*] Screwdriver: Dice Bonus +1 -> +2
[/list]

[h2]Balance: Reward Pool Adjustment[/h2]
Due to the overwhelming number of cards, making it difficult to build the desired bag, the following tools will no longer appear as rewards:
[list]
[*] Knife: Removed as it has too low value for a starting tool.
[*] Coat: Removed as it has too low value for a starting tool.
[*] Stone Throw: Removed due to being redundant with Broken Robot's damage.
[*] Infighting: Removed as the max damage is 3 and can be easily replaced by other turn tools.
[*] Jeer: Removed as it is redundant with Purge's effect.
[*] Garbage Dump: Removed as it can be replaced by tools like Golf Club, Equivalent Exchange, and Scope.
[*] Water Cannon: Removed as it can be replaced by Rusty Knife.
[*] Corroded Dart: Removed due to low usage frequency.
[*] Catapult: Removed due to low usage frequency.
[/list]

[h2]Balance: Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy character tools will no longer appear as boss rewards.

[*] As 'Stone Throw' is no longer part of the game, the following changes apply:
Broken Robot: 15 -> 12 damage
Frau: Instead of [Stone Throw, Broken Robot], she now starts with [2 Broken Robots] in her bag.
(Since Broken Robot’s damage has been reduced, Frau’s total deck damage remains the same.)

[*] To increase the chance of building the desired bag, shops will now display more items for purchase.
[*] Bored ‘He’: Draw count 1 -> 2
[*] Smiling ‘He’: Draw count 1 -> 2
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where ‘Concentration’ UI would display without being affected by condition improvements.
[*] Fixed an issue where 'Purge' was displayed as --1.
[*] Fixed an issue where some text did not match the actual damage values.
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage text for 'Torch' was not updated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage effect appeared for 'Rehabilitation' without the damage actually increasing.
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage text for 'Contradictory Morality' was always 2. We still won't tell you what changed it, because it's alien...
[*] Fixed an issue where the animation target for ‘Explosive Roulette’ differed from the actual damage target.
[*] Added a ‘Save and Return to Title’ feature to the menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes – September 18, 2024

Hello,

[*] Fixed a discrepancy between the required removal count and the actual count in the Castor event.
[*] The "Time Management Subsystem" of the Act 3 boss will no longer speed up the game.
[*] Fixed a repeated map bug when selecting "Shop" as a reward option and encountering the same map again.

[*] Fixed a bug where the log kept displaying maximum HP recovery despite being 0.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game options were affected by the screen resolution.
[/list]

[h2]Removal of Priority Mechanic[/h2]
Based on feedback that the priority mechanic overly relied on luck, it has been removed. Now, allies will always take turns before enemies. Traits related to priority have also been removed.

[h2]Changes to Act 2/3 Introductory Rewards[/h2]
The options of +1 dice or +1 draw at the start of Acts 2 and 3 were deemed overpowered, so they have been adjusted as follows: 
[list]
[*] Hic's Rear Support: Max HP +50%, Draw +1.
[*] Illa's Rear Support: Adds dice [1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3], Draw +1.
[*] Is's Rear Support: Gain 2 traits, Draw +1.
[/list]

[h2]Tool Pool Changes on Creation[/h2]
When creating random tools, the following tool types have been excluded. This applies to both players and enemies, including the Act 3 final boss: 
[list]
[*] Tools that destroy your own tools. 
[*] Tools related to gold.
[*] Tools that deal self-damage.
[*] Tools that remove characters.
[*] Tools with draw effects.
[/list]

[h2]Tool Balance Patch[/h2]
The following tools have been rebalanced:

[list]
[*] Brawl: [Condition] 4+ -> 5+.
[*] Time Bomb: [Condition] 7+ -> 9+.
[*] Gold Throw: [Effect] 5% of gold -> 2% damage.
[*] Pepper Spray: [Effect] 5 -> 7 damage to all enemies.
[*] Umbrella: [Effect] Ignores 3 -> 5 defense.
[*] Trash Bin: [Condition] 2+ -> 1+.
[*] Purge: [Effect] +1 -> -1 dice bonus.
[*] Throw Trash: [Effect] 5+ -> 3+.
[*] Acid Rain: [Effect] 1 -> 3 damage to all.
[*] Little by Little: [Effect] Gain 1G -> 2G per turn.
[*] Double Axe: [Condition] 10- -> 15- / [Effect] 2x -> 3x dice bonus damage.
[*] Steroids: [Effect] +3 -> +4 dice bonus.
[*] Steel Sword: [Effect] 1x -> 2x condition value damage.
[*] Espresso: [Condition] 10- -> 15-.
[*] Bag Toss: [Effect] Damage equal to the number of tools in the bag -> 2x the number of tools.
[*] Pencil: [Effect] 1x -> 2x condition value damage.
[*] Static Shock: [Effect] 1 -> 4 damage.
[*] Rusty Knife: [Condition] 6+ -> 8+.
[*] Chainsaw: [Effect] 20 -> 15 damage.
[*] Imsal Experiment: [Effect] 10 -> 7 damage to self.
[*] Coin Pickup: [Effect] 5G+ -> 10G+.
[*] Slime Toy: [Effect] Makes a tool 3x harder to use -> 2x harder.
[*] Driver: [Condition] Has 3 -> 3+.
[*] Swing: [Effect] 15 -> 12 damage.
[*] Launch: [Effect] Starts at 1 -> 3 damage.
[*] Preach: [Effect] Adds as many "Preach" cards as dice to the deck.
[*] Endless Worship: [Effect] Damage equal to dice bonus, no reduction to dice total bonus.
[*] Rope: [Effect] Ignores 2 -> 3 defense.
[*] Gloves: [Effect] +2 draw, -3 dice bonus.
[*] Stimpak: [Effect] 1 -> 4 damage when activated.
[*] Painkillers: [Effect] +5 defense, -2 max HP.
[/list]

[h2]Trait Balance Patch[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game Strategy: Reduces all enemy HP by 20% -> 10% at the start of combat.
[*] Efficiency Study: When activating a tool with no effect, it now deals 2 damage to a random enemy instead of 1.
[*] Finishing Blow: Now limited to once per battle.
[*] Penny Pincher: Now gives 15G -> 10G after combat.
[*] "Hesitant," "Overwhelming Strength," and "Oath of Victory" have been removed from traits.
[*] Slow Starter, Fast Starter, Quick, and Vanguard have been removed due to the removal of the priority system.
[/list]

[h2]Character Balance Patch[/h2]
Obrefo: No longer carries "Gloves" in their deck.
Alien Laser: HP reduced from 30 -> 20.


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Fixed an issue where the "Skilled Accuracy" trait would trigger only when the exact value was 2, instead of triggering when two dice with the same value were rolled.
Fixed an issue where the dice bonus UI would progressively increase in size.
Fixed an issue where the "Loss of Free Will" trait would activate even when there were other combat choices available.
Fixed an issue where a void was generated on the player's board when an ally activated "Mental Pollution."

notes.title: Notice: Game Release Date Postponed by One Week
notes.notes:
Hello,

We regret to inform you that the game's release date has been postponed by a week, from September 6th to September 13th.

After returning from the BIC exhibition, all of our team members contracted COVID-19, making it difficult to maintain our normal development pace. Although we wore masks during the exhibition, it seems we got infected during travel or meal times.

As COVID-19 is spreading widely across the country, we hope you all stay safe and healthy as well. We will work even harder once everyone has fully recovered.

Thank you for your understanding.


+ Please note that the demo update scheduled for August 25th will also be postponed by one week. The September 1st update will proceed as planned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047757/71e557eec7817edd2f61821ed224f2f4b816a58f.png[/img]

As the Collapsed Balance achievement has reached 2.5%, Infinite Mode loop elements and rankings have been added. 
You can check your rank under "Title Screen > Infinite Mode Ranking" The ranking score will be recorded as your highest score for each loop.

As previously announced, constraints for loops beyond 5 have been added:

5th Loop Penalty: All tools in your bag start with one condition harder. (Applied once in total)
10th Loop Penalty: All tools in your bag start with two conditions harder. (Applied three times in total)
15th Loop Penalty: All tools in your bag start with three conditions harder. (Applied six times in total)
Each multiple of 5 loops will add an additional constraint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047757/21fd4d4fb468862c057940bd13087486d41ed1b8.jpg[/img]

Vitamin: Single-use, instant activation, HP +5

[h2]Affinity System Added[/h2]
An affinity system has been added, affecting the probability of bosses appearing based on story choices.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45047757/39f09e26270017ed7d9840f3ec2b4c63d4fc9aa7.gif[/img]

The higher the affinity, the lower the probability of that group appearing in boss battles. Conversely, the lower the affinity, the higher the probability of that group appearing in boss battles.


[h2]User Experience Improvements[/h2]
- Game speed can now be adjusted up to 3x in settings/gameplay.
- The health UI is now displayed outside of battles.
- A rolling animation has been added when dice are rolled in story choices.
- An animation has been added when an item is added to the bag.
- An animation has been added to the gold number when the gold value changes.
- Shop operations have been simplified to no longer require drag actions.


[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]

- [Tool] The effect of the 'Brawl' tool has been changed.
Damage equal to the character's defense => Damage equal to the character's defense, defense reduced by 50%.

- [Reward] The composition of battle tool rewards has been changed.
3 tools from the enemy character's bag => 2 tools from the enemy character's bag + 1 random tool.


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- [Tool] Fixed an issue where 'Hacking' could not progress if there were no opposing characters.
- [Tool] Fixed an issue where 'Emergency Activated Turret' was always activated regardless of conditions.
- [Tool] Fixed an issue where the 'Fire' effect text did not change when drawn.
- [Rest] Fixed an issue where 'Easier Tool Conditions' was not applied in battles.

This will be updated in the demo next week.
